lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲，只有我在走。
lines.en: In the basalt deltas, only I walk.

lines.zh: 我的腿比炽足兽粗一圈。
lines.en: My legs are a size thicker than a strider's.

lines.zh: 岩浆在脚下，我踩得很稳。
lines.en: Lava lies under my feet, and I step surely.

lines.zh: 长毛拖在地上，扫过黑石。
lines.en: My long hair drags and sweeps the black stone.
The ash is hot wherever I have walked.

lines.zh: 三角洲的风把我的毛吹开。
lines.en: The delta wind parts my long coat.

lines.zh: 我一步一步巡这片领地。
lines.en: I patrol this ground one heavy step at a time.

lines.zh: 水坑拦不住我，我照样过。
lines.en: A puddle cannot stop me; I cross it anyway.

lines.zh: 岸边的玄武岩被我踩碎。
lines.en: The basalt at the shore crumbles under me.
The ground burns my soles, and I find it pleasant.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，但每一步都重。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but every step lands heavy.

lines.zh: 这片灰原，从这头到那头。
lines.en: This ashen plain, from one end to the other.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲，只有我这样的脚走。
lines.en: Only feet like mine walk the basalt deltas.
Don't even think about touching my flames.
The basalt path is narrow. Stand aside.
Hmph. Taking my time.
Gravel crunching underfoot. Annoying.

lines.zh: 蹄子碾过碎石，冒起白烟。
lines.en: My hooves crush the gravel and white smoke rises.
This thick hide turns even arrows.
Three steps, three scorched hoofprints.
The hot wind carries the smell of raw meat.

lines.zh: 玄武岩柱之间，我走得比炽足兽稳。
lines.en: Between basalt pillars I walk steadier than a strider.

lines.zh: 玄武岩的碎石，硌着我的蹄。
lines.en: Basalt gravel grinds under my hooves.
A figure up ahead. I'll take a look.

lines.zh: 我站着，把毛铺在岩浆上。
lines.en: I stand and spread my hair over the lava.
Heat rises from below.

lines.zh: 我听着岩浆冒泡的声音。
lines.en: I listen to the lava bubbling.
The delta is silent except for fire.

lines.zh: 我的长毛在风里缠成一团。
lines.en: My long hair tangles in the wind.
I wait for someone to step onto this black stone.
I blink slowly, and my lids feel heavy.
Ash settles on my back, and I do not shake it off.
Striders are far off; I ignore them.
I smell someone who does not belong here.
The heat is drying me out.

lines.zh: 我这副宽蹄，踩着玄武岩走。
lines.en: These wide hooves tread on basalt.
In lava, I move as if in water.

lines.zh: 蹲在岩柱边，听熔岩咕嘟。
lines.en: Crouched by a basalt pillar, I listen to the lava bubble.
The Nether sky has never once been bright.

lines.zh: 嗓子发痒，吼一声震震灰。
lines.en: My throat itches; a roar will shake off the ash.
I forgot how to sit down.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲，我趴一会儿。
lines.en: I lie a while on the basalt delta.

lines.zh: 这块柱岩，歪得像老家伙。
lines.en: This basalt pillar leans like an old fellow.
Smells like sulfur here.

lines.zh: 你踩进来的第一步，我就看见了。
lines.en: I saw your very first step in.

lines.zh: 这里是玄武岩三角洲，我的。
lines.en: This is the basalt delta, and it is mine.

lines.zh: 你在看我的毛？它比你的绳子长。
lines.en: You stare at my hair? It is longer than your rope.

lines.zh: 你的甲很亮，可惜挡不住我。
lines.en: Your armor shines, but it will not stop me.

lines.zh: 谁准你站在我的黑石上？
lines.en: Who allowed you onto my black stone?

lines.zh: 你身上有岩浆烫不到的味。
lines.en: You carry a scent the lava cannot burn away.

lines.zh: 我盯你，是把你当入侵者。
lines.en: I stare at you because I count you an invader.

lines.zh: 别假装路过，这里没有路。
lines.en: Do not pretend to pass through; there is no path.

lines.zh: 你把武器放下，我或许再想想。
lines.en: Lower your weapon, and I may reconsider.

lines.zh: 你脚下的黑石，我记下了。
lines.en: I have noted the black stone under your feet.
Are you here to deliver something?

lines.zh: 我的长毛一甩，蝌蚪就飞出去。
lines.en: One flick of my hair and a tadpole flies out.

lines.zh: 熔岩里我走得比你还稳。
lines.en: I walk lava steadier than you walk stone.
Your legs are shaking. I can smell it.

lines.zh: 那东西亮，能换几块金子。
lines.en: That thing shines. It could trade for gold.
I walk steady on basalt.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲的风，全带硫味。
lines.en: Every wind in the basalt deltas tastes of sulfur.
Don't come closer. It's hot.

lines.zh: 你这层皮，我蹄子一碰就破。
lines.en: One touch of my hoof would split that hide.

lines.zh: 你口袋里，叮当响的是金？
lines.en: What jingles in your pocket — gold?
You dare strike me? Then you will not leave.
The arrow bounces off my hide.
That scraped through my hair.
I roar once, and the ash falls from me.
It hurts, but I am angrier.
My thick hide takes most of it.
I turn my head; I have remembered you.
Claws rake along my flank.
I do not retreat; I step forward.
Blood drips onto black stone and steams.

lines.zh: 我在这片玄武岩上，走得像在熔岩里。
lines.en: On this basalt I walk as if in lava.

lines.zh: 你手里那根东西，扎得疼。
lines.en: That thing in your hand stings.

lines.zh: 我在熔岩里比在陆地上自在。
lines.en: I'm freer in lava than on land.
Easy with that. Even this hide feels pain.
Lava feels like warm water to me.

lines.zh: 这一下，我会连本带利还。
lines.en: I'll repay that with interest.
I'm fine. Keep going.

lines.zh: 熔岩我照走，水我也照走。
lines.en: Lava or water, I walk both.

lines.zh: 玄武岩的尖，扎进我的皮。
lines.en: A basalt shard went into my hide.
Thick hide only goes so far.
Is that crimson fungus you are carrying?

lines.zh: 那点红，我从灰里能闻出来。
lines.en: I can smell that red through all this ash.
Raise it higher; I cannot see clearly.
Food may pass, but people may not.
I will not step aside for a snack.

lines.zh: 你晃那东西的样子很蠢。
lines.en: You look foolish waving that thing around.

lines.zh: 靠近一步，我就当你来抢。
lines.en: One more step, and I will treat it as theft.

lines.zh: 绯红菌的味道压过了灰味。
lines.en: The crimson fungus overpowers the smell of ash.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，只是为了闻。
lines.en: I stretch my neck only to sniff it.

lines.zh: 喂完就退开，别摸我的毛。
lines.en: Feed me, then step back and do not touch my hair.

lines.zh: 给一口，我这大个子好打发。
lines.en: One bite. A big fellow like me is easy to please.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲，你在逗我。
lines.en: Basalt Deltas — are you kidding me?
Don't throw it. Bend down and set it on the ground.
Two more steps and I can reach it.
Wait. Don't put it away yet.

lines.zh: 我拿玄武岩跟你换，成不？
lines.en: I'll trade you basalt. Deal?

lines.zh: 岩浆里煮过的东西最香。
lines.en: Things boiled in lava taste best.
Upworlders bring such good things.
Two riders fit on my back.
My mouth waters and drips onto the rock.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞一堵热墙。
lines.en: You hit me like a hot wall.

lines.zh: 我的护甲厚，你的肩膀会疼。
lines.en: My hide is thick, and your shoulder will ache.
Move; my legs do not turn aside.
You are shoved half a step and find your footing.

lines.zh: 我的毛擦过你的脸，很烫。
lines.en: My hair brushes your face, and it is hot.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我会当成推挤。
lines.en: Do not press so close; I read it as a shove.

lines.zh: 我身子一动，地面都闷响。
lines.en: When I shift, the ground gives a muffled thud.

lines.zh: 你在我的影子里，太近了。
lines.en: You stand in my shadow, far too close.

lines.zh: 我顶你是提醒，不是动手。
lines.en: I headbutt you as a reminder, not an attack.
I will not move aside, so go around.
You stepped on my foot.

lines.zh: 再来一下，我这身皮扛得住。
lines.en: Again. This hide can take it.
Huff — you hit my ribs.

lines.zh: 你这一撞，倒有几分力气。
lines.en: That was a decent shove.
There's hard bone under this hide. Don't test it.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲，我走得比谁都稳。
lines.en: On basalt deltas, I walk steadier than anyone.
It's hot. Step back half a pace.
You knocked my flames sideways.
The pillars crowd me; I can't turn around.

lines.zh: 玄武岩把我角蹭出一道白痕。
lines.en: Basalt left a white streak on my horn.
She stands on the far side of the lava pool.
We look at each other through rising heat.
I show her the longest strands of my coat.
The stone glows red beneath her feet.
Two straddlers walk side by side.
We settle the boundary with low growls.
She walks over, kicking up a sheet of ash.
I give up a small patch of lava for her.

lines.zh: 幼崽会从池边的卵里出来。
lines.en: The young will hatch from eggs by the pool.
She brushes my flank, and it burns.
Shall we share this fire side by side?
You didn't flinch. That's a yes.
Those horns on your head look fine.

lines.zh: 有我在，岩崩也压不着你。
lines.en: With me here, even a rockfall won't crush you.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲，我很少开口。
lines.en: Basalt deltas — I rarely speak.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲是我唯一的地盘。
lines.en: Basalt Deltas are my only home.
Will you stand beside me?

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲，热得正好。
lines.en: The basalt deltas are just hot enough.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲，我唱得难听。
lines.en: In the basalt deltas, my song is ugly.
That huff was me calling you.

lines.zh: 我用长毛卷起一块玄武岩。
lines.en: I curl a piece of basalt up with my hair.
The stone is too heavy and drops back where it lay.

lines.zh: 我把幼崽叼在毛里带走。
lines.en: I carry a young one away in my coat.

lines.zh: 掉下来的晶石，我踢到一边。
lines.en: I kick the fallen crystal aside.

lines.zh: 这些东西对我没什么用。
lines.en: These things are of little use to me.
I scrape the black stone open with my foot.

lines.zh: 岩浆里浮着的东西，我不碰。
lines.en: I leave the things floating in the lava alone.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块热的石头暖脚。
lines.en: I pick up a hot stone to warm my feet.

lines.zh: 那枚跨座晶石，你拿去吧。
lines.en: Take that straddlite; it is yours.
Bits of grit are tangled in my coat.
Found at my feet for free. Not bad luck.
I won't ask who dropped it. It's mine now.

lines.zh: 这块石头颜色配我的皮。
lines.en: This stone's color matches my hide.
Nobody grab it.

lines.zh: 这块晶石，我蹄子踩住了。
lines.en: This crystal is under my hoof.

lines.zh: 拿去猪灵那边，能换金锭。
lines.en: The piglins will trade gold ingots for this.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲，亮晶晶的。
lines.en: Basalt Deltas — all glitter.
Not broken. I'll tuck it in a fold of hide.
Heavy, but worth it.
I'll show the others.

lines.zh: 有人越过了三角洲的边线。
lines.en: Someone has crossed the delta's boundary line.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，网毛开始张开。
lines.en: I lift my head, and my netted hair begins to spread.

lines.zh: 那个影子在我的领地中央。
lines.en: That figure stands at the center of my ground.

lines.zh: 我选定了，就是那个举剑的。
lines.en: I have chosen: the one holding the sword.
He does not retreat, and that is a challenge.

lines.zh: 我把他记成第一个目标。
lines.en: I mark him as my first target.

lines.zh: 又有一个人从灰里冒出来。
lines.en: Another person rises out of the ash.
Every tip of my hair stands up.
Whoever moves first gets hit first.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，把他圈进视线。
lines.en: I turn slowly and pull him into my sight.

lines.zh: 这个距离，够我吐一只蝌蚪了。
lines.en: At this range, I can spit a stradpole.

lines.zh: 我锁住他，直到他离开黑石。
lines.en: I hold him in my sight until he leaves the stone.

lines.zh: 远处的炽足兽不算，他只算。
lines.en: The distant striders do not count; only he does.

lines.zh: 我的目标从头到尾只有一个。
lines.en: From first to last, I have only one target.
That flesh will last me till dawn.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲，热气升起来了。
lines.en: Heat rises off the basalt deltas.

lines.zh: 玄武岩上，我一步就到了。
lines.en: One step on the basalt and I am there.
I see you between the basalt pillars.

lines.zh: 我两只眼，都钉在你身上。
lines.en: Both my eyes are fixed on you.

lines.zh: 这片玄武岩地，你两条腿跑不掉。
lines.en: This basalt field, two legs will not carry you out.

lines.zh: 你自己走到我蹄下来了。
lines.en: You walked right under my hooves.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲里，我横着走。
lines.en: In the basalt deltas I stride wide.
You stepped on my ground.

lines.zh: 过来，让我掂掂你的分量。
lines.en: Come here. Let me weigh you.
I can walk across lava.
This time nothing survives my hooves.
Lava all around. Where will you run?
Stop. Don't look back at me.
I pull my hair taut like a net.
He runs left, and I turn more slowly.

lines.zh: 我在算他会不会跳过来。
lines.en: I am judging whether he will jump across.
My eyes are fixed on his knees.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里有东西在动。
lines.en: Something is stirring in my throat.
Two steps closer, and he is in reach.
He raises his shield, so I wait for it to drop.
My breath blows the ash apart.

lines.zh: 别以为绕到背后就安全。
lines.en: Do not think my back makes you safe.
I keep watching him without blinking.

lines.zh: 他退到水边，我知道他要跑。
lines.en: He backs toward the water; I know he will run.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，准备下一次吐。
lines.en: I lower my body for the next spit.
This stradpole is meant for his face.
I count his steps: one, two.

lines.zh: 前面热浪滚着，你走进去。
lines.en: Heat rolls ahead. You're walking into it.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲，我走得最稳。
lines.en: On the basalt deltas, I walk steadiest.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲，我横着走。
lines.en: I stride sideways across the basalt deltas.
Lava or land — neither bothers me.

lines.zh: 这味道，粘在我的鼻子上。
lines.en: This scent sticks to my snout.

lines.zh: 我蹲在岩上，能耗一整天。
lines.en: I can crouch on this rock all day.
My hide isn't even warm and you run.
Left of that is a lava lake.

lines.zh: 绕岩柱也甩不掉我的蹄。
lines.en: The pillars won't shake my hooves.
The hoofbeats are closer. Hear them?
I hear your footsteps.
Catch your breath. I'm in no rush.

lines.zh: 你在往熔岩湖的死路跑。
lines.en: You are running down a dead end to a lava lake.
On basalt, I can wait.

lines.zh: 我一头撞过去，他退了三步。
lines.en: I ram him, and he staggers back three steps.
My head strikes him like a hammer.
This blow carries the heat of lava.
He blocks, and his shield dents.
My hair lashes across his arm.
It lands, and I add another.
He dares to hit back, so I hit harder.

lines.zh: 两点的力气，配上五点的甲。
lines.en: Two points of force behind five points of armor.

lines.zh: 我把他顶开，离岩浆远些。
lines.en: I shove him off, away from the lava.

lines.zh: 这一脚踩下去，灰都飞了。
lines.en: I stomp, and the ash flies up.
He is bleeding; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我不追，只把他赶出边界。
lines.en: I do not chase; I only drive him past the line.

lines.zh: 他再靠近，我就再撞一次。
lines.en: If he comes close again, I will ram again.
My horns are short, but my head is hard.
My hoof missed. The next one won't.
Don't fall. I'm not done.
You step back; I step in.
Duck. My hooves are coming down!

lines.zh: 在陆地上，我也一样有劲。
lines.en: On land, I am just as strong.

lines.zh: 别躲，站稳，我这就撞过来。
lines.en: Don't dodge, stand firm, here I come.
The hoof landed. Don't force yourself up.
This one's a thank-you.
Flame rises off my back.

lines.zh: 水里和陆上，我都一样快。
lines.en: Water and land, I move the same.
Touch me and your hand will blister.
Quiet. Even the lava is quieter.
This kick lands on basalt.

lines.zh: 火苗顺着我前蹄扑过去。
lines.en: Flame runs down my forelegs at you.

lines.zh: 我从玄武岩的裂缝里站起。
lines.en: I rise from a crack in the basalt.
Ash falls, and I shake off a coat of it.

lines.zh: 岩浆池边，多了一头大兽。
lines.en: A great beast now stands by the lava pool.

lines.zh: 我的第一声吼震动了黑石。
lines.en: My first roar shakes the black stone.
The delta is mine to rule again.
I walk out of the rising heat.
My long hair still holds hardened stone.
I know the smell of this place.
I take my first step, and ash rises.

lines.zh: 又一头跨座兽占了这片灰原。
lines.en: Another straddler claims this ashen plain.
I lift my head to the red sky.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这条路只许我走。
lines.en: From today, only I walk this way.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲的火，烧起来了。
lines.en: The basalt delta fire has caught.

lines.zh: 这块新岩地，得先踩一遍。
lines.en: I need to tread this new basalt first.
Who woke me up?

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲，是我的院子。
lines.en: The basalt delta is my yard.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲的光，刺得我低头。
lines.en: The delta's glare makes me lower my head.
The basalt is hot underfoot, and I walk anyway.
A stroll in lava, nothing more.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲的热气，熟悉。
lines.en: The basalt deltas' heat, so familiar.

lines.zh: 在陆上和水里，我都一样走。
lines.en: On land or in water, I walk the same.
Just woke. Let me stretch a hoof.
The lava's still warm, and so am I.

lines.zh: 玄武岩上，我的脚还没落稳。
lines.en: On the basalt, my feet are not set yet.

lines.zh: 火？我天天站在岩浆边上。
lines.en: Fire? I stand beside lava every day.
Don't use fire on me.

lines.zh: 从黑石上摔下，我翻身就起。
lines.en: I tumble off the black stone and roll upright.
Falling from the pillar numbed my hooves.

lines.zh: 水让我难受，可我淹不死。
lines.en: Water sickens me, but it cannot drown me.
Water is harder to swim than lava.

lines.zh: 气浪掀翻我，我翻正身子。
lines.en: The shockwave flips me, and I right myself.
Gunpowder stings my nose and my ears ring.
The arrow lodges in my hair and will not pull free.
An arrow in my back. Who shot it?

lines.zh: 药水在我皮上冒着紫泡。
lines.en: The potion bubbles purple on my hide.

lines.zh: 魔法打在身上，走得慢些。
lines.en: Magic lands, and I walk a little slower.
Starving, I even chew the ash.

lines.zh: 玄武岩三角洲里，我找不到吃的。
lines.en: In the basalt deltas I find nothing to eat.
Lightning strikes, and my whole coat stands up.
Numb. All numb.

lines.zh: 虚空很冷，我不属于那里。
lines.en: The void is cold, and I do not belong there.

lines.zh: 虚空里没岩可踩，蹄在打滑。
lines.en: No rock in the void; my hooves slip.
